about: Built by tools/build_rosecliff.py. The grounds come from OpenStreetMap (the estate boundary is approximate); floors 1 and 2 are traced from Stanford White’s 1902 plans in the McKim, Mead & White Monograph (plate 173), turned so north is up. Floor 2 is now the exhibition floor; its route may differ from the old bedrooms. The basement has no published plan: only its outline is drawn, and the places in it are approximate.
source: OpenStreetMap (grounds), A Monograph of the Work of McKim, Mead & White, plate 173 (plans of floors 1 and 2), the Preservation Society of Newport County’s accessibility page (visitor facilities)
units: grounds: metres x 2.4, north up; house: pixels of the plate x 0.6, turned north up
